name: Netdata Monitor
author: bonesgit
description: Netdata GPU utilization, temperature, memory, and power monitor for the Omarchy bar, with history popup.

barWidget.description: Status pill for a remote Netdata host, with GPU utilization, temperature, memory, and power history.

schema.label: Polls at normal cadence before backoff
schema.description: Consecutive failed live polls before the wait starts doubling (capped at a 5-minute liveness probe). A successful poll resets the counter. The poller auto-stops once the retry window expires.

schema.label: Max retry time (minutes)
schema.description: How long to keep retrying an unreachable host before giving up and switching to Stopped (1-1440, default 120 = 2 hours). Any successful poll resets the window; restarting the poller starts a fresh window.

schema.label: GPU
schema.description: Picks the Netdata utilization, temperature, memory, and power charts. Blank is the same as nvidia. context, tempContext, memContext, and powerContext override those picks.

schema.label: GPU memory context override
schema.description: Overrides the GPU memory chart context (default nvidia_smi.gpu_frame_buffer_memory_usage / amdgpu.gpu_mem_vram_usage). Only the used dimension is shown.

schema.label: GPU power context override
schema.description: Overrides the GPU power chart context (default nvidia_smi.gpu_power_draw / the amdgpu sensors power instance).

schema.label: Per-GPU lines
schema.description: Draw one line per GPU on both charts instead of one averaged line.

schema.label: Show temperature
schema.description: Hide the temperature section (and stop polling it) when off.

schema.label: Show memory
schema.description: Hide the GPU memory section (and stop polling it) when off.

schema.label: Show power draw
schema.description: Hide the GPU power section (and stop polling it) when off.
